highlights: Private, generous enclosed garden to rear
summary: Located in this ever popular and sought after Eden Valley village, easily accessible to Penrith and historic Appleby, a deceivingly well proportioned, spacious and flexible, 4/5 bedroom traditional Georgian sandstone family home with generous enclosed garden and attached annexe / cottage.
description:
Offered to the market with no onward chain and presented in well-maintained order throughout, The White House represents an exceptional opportunity to acquire a highly attractive family residence within this sought-after village. The property retains a wealth of original features, lending considerable charm and character.

Constructed of local red sandstone and dating in parts back to the eighteenth century, the house occupies a prominent position and benefits from ample off-road parking and an attractive horseshoe courtyard. To the rear, the property enjoys a generous and private garden with adjoining orchard and pedestrian access.

The accommodation is both flexible and well proportioned, comprising a stone-flagged entrance hallway, a living room with access to the garden, sitting room, dining room, dining kitchen and pantry with adjoining ground-floor WC.

To the first floor are four principal bedrooms, one of which benefits from an en-suite bath room, together with two further family bathrooms.

In addition to the main house, an attached building has been thoughtfully converted to create a self-contained annexe. This provides ideal accommodation for a dependent relative or offers excellent potential as a holiday let or rental unit, and comprises a living room, dining kitchen, and double bedroom with en-suite bathroom.

Long Marton is conveniently situated just off the A66, providing easy access to the nearby market town of Appleby (under 15 minutes away), which offers a range of amenities including supermarkets, medical facilities, Appleby Grammar School, and the Carlisle to Settle railway station. Penrith is also within approximately 15 minutes’ drive via the A66, offering a wider range of services and amenities.

Offering significant potential, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this impressive property has to offer.

Directions From Penrith take the A66 east towards Appleby and having passed through Kirkby Thore turn left signposted Long Marton. Travel along this road and at the T junction turn left. Head over the bridge and up the hill and the property is on the right hand side as the road bends left into the village centre.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
